title: 1812 blockhouse cupola lookouts and shingled roofs
items: Each cupola cap on the first fort's two blockhouses now has a small hooded lookout opening on all four sides, as Currey's drawing shows.
Shingle roofs across town are redrawn as riven shingles: mixed widths, broken joints and a weathered tone on each shingle, where they used to read as a flat plane.
